sloka: तेन मार्गेण गच्छन्तो निरीक्षन्तो नराधिपम् ।येन मार्गम् च भूमिम् च निरीक्षन्ते स्म ते मृगाः ॥३-६४-१९॥
transliteration: tena mārgeṇa gacchanto nirīkṣanto narādhipam ।yena mārgam ca bhūmim ca nirīkṣante sma te mṛgāḥ ॥3-64-19॥

translations.english: Even Lakshmana marked that the deer were showing and looking at the path lying in that direction.
